title: The field made by a held source as a common local scale for a test body

key_results.statement: Partial expectation of the total contract in the field state: $\bar C_\varphi=C_{bc}+\gamma\sum_x N_\varphi(x)Q_x+E_\varphi\mathbb 1$, fixed by $C$ and $\varphi$; its split into own and field-made parts is listing-dependent.

Couplings (a), (c), every field state, product starts: $\lVert\Psi(\lambda)-\xi(\lambda)\otimes\varphi(\lambda)\rVert\le|\gamma|c_Q\int_0^{|\lambda|}\sigma_\Phi$, with $\xi$ evolving by $\bar C_{\varphi(\lambda)}$; first order in $\gamma$, valid for $|\lambda|\ll(|\gamma|c_Q\sigma_\Phi)^{-1}$; in the lowest adapted state $\sigma_\Phi^2\le\max_y N(y)$.

Level-$k$ blocks of $ ar C_\varphi$: on-site $
u(x)M_k\sigma_3+E_\varphi\mathbb 1_2$ with $
u=1+\gamma N_\varphi$; hopping $	au$ for (a), $	au rac12(
u(x)+
u(x+1))$ for (c); fixed by $C$ and $\varphi$: $M_{x,k}$, hoppings, ratios $M_{y,k}/M_{x,k}$; listing-dependent: the factorization $
u(x)M_k$ and the constant in $V_{x,k}$.

For (a) and (c), every field state and every place, R3 holds with $\Gamma(x)=\gamma(N_\varphi(x+1)-N_\varphi(x))\sigma_3$; the hopping scales with the on-site factor (bond mean) for (c), not for (a) wherever $\gamma(N_\varphi(x+1)-N_\varphi(x))\neq0$.
Control: coupling only the rest term, $Q_x=\Pi_x\sigma_3\otimes m\mathbb 1_N$; R3 fails and the fall from rest is level dependent at every place with $\gamma(N_\varphi(x+1)-N_\varphi(x))\neq0$.

Stationary field state, (a) or (c), $
u>0$: clock-rate ratio $r(y)/r(x)=
u(y)/
u(x)=M_{y,k}/M_{x,k}$ for every pair of levels and both branches, exact in $ ar C_\varphi$.

Branch start at rest, local slope, first order in gradients: $a_{k,\sigma}(0)=-\tau_{\rm loc}(x_0)^2\gamma N'(x_0)/\nu(x_0)$, level and branch independent; (4.24) holds with $v_{\max}=\tau_{\rm loc}(x_0)d_0$, equal to $\tau d_0$ for (a) and to $\tau\nu(x_0)d_0$ for (c).
Lowest adapted state $u_g^{\otimes N_f}$, unique for every real $g_s$: $N(y)=n-\frac{2ng_s}{t_f}\Lambda^+(y,x_s)+O(N_f g_s^2/(t_f\omega_{\min})^2)$.
On the ring, $\Lambda^+(x,x_s)=\frac{L^2-1}{12L}-\frac{\varrho(L-\varrho)}{2L}$ with $\varrho$ the ring distance from the source.
Made field, first order in $g_s$: $r(y)/r(x)=1+\frac{2n\bar\gamma g_s}{t_f}[\Lambda^+(x,x_s)-\Lambda^+(y,x_s)]$ with $\bar\gamma=\gamma/(1+\gamma n)$.
Made field, first order in $g_s$, local slope: $a_{k,\sigma}(0)=\frac{2n\bar\gamma g_s}{t_f}\tau_0^2\,\partial_\ell\Lambda^+(x_0,x_s)$, level and branch independent.

Ring: $r(y)/r(x)=1+\frac{n\bar\gamma g_s}{t_fL}[\varrho_y(L-\varrho_y)-\varrho_x(L-\varrho_x)]$, $a=-\frac{n\bar\gamma g_s}{t_f}\tau_0^2(1-2\varrho/L)$ (positive away from the source), for $w\ll\varrho$, $w\ll L/2-\varrho$.

Tori, $1\ll\varrho\ll L$: clock ratio logarithmic ($D=2$) or $1/\varrho$ ($D=3$), acceleration along $\ell$ the projection of a radial vector $\propto\varrho^{-1}$ or $\varrho^{-2}$; for $g_s\gamma>0$ slower clocks and fall towards the source, for $g_s\gamma<0$ faster clocks and fall away.

open_issues: The bound (5.2) grows linearly in λ; a bound using the field gap t_f ω_min (non-growing first-order remainder plus the second-order own mark) is not derived.
The remainder of (5.8), taken from (3.9) per field object, is crude (N_f g_s²/(t_f ω_min)²); a sharp second-order profile is not derived.
Non-product starts and non-stationary field states for items 3–4 (λ-dependent profile) are not treated.
Regions with ν(x) ≤ 0, the neighbourhoods ϱ ≲ w of the source, the ring antipode and ϱ ~ L on the tori are outside the formulas.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of the remainder, the clock ratio and the acceleration
g_s = 0 or γ = 0: uniform field, Γ = 0, ratio 1, no fall, vanishing remainder
Sharp field (t_f = 0, joint eigenvector of all Φ_x): (5.2) exact, given lapse field of 05-ilang-free-fall recovered
